nodes.label: OriginFlow PLM Platform
nodes.rationale: Internal product launch/lifecycle platform coordinating a product from RFQ through development to production; success is a PM running many concurrent launches without losing the thread, optimizing for speed and clarity at scale.

nodes.label: Internal Product Managers / Admins (Klarstein staff)
nodes.rationale: Primary users: high-frequency operational power users who value density, speed, and knowing exactly where every launch stands.

nodes.label: External Suppliers (factories/vendors)
nodes.rationale: Secondary users entering through token-based portals; occasional users in unfamiliar territory who need clarity and light guidance rather than density.

nodes.label: Brand Personality: Calm, Precise, Trustworthy
nodes.rationale: Earns trust the way good operational software does, by being predictable and honest about state, not by impressing; plain direct voice, restrained color.

nodes.label: OriginFlow Design Principles
nodes.rationale: Five principles: tool disappears into the task; status at a glance; trust through precision (no silent failure); density with hierarchy; guide the occasional user.

nodes.label: Anti-references (generic SaaS / consumer-flashy)
nodes.rationale: Rejects generic SaaS template scaffolding and consumer-flashy marketing aesthetics; density must always be ranked by hierarchy, never a gray wall of undifferentiated controls.

nodes.label: Accessibility Target WCAG 2.1 AA
nodes.rationale: Body text >=4.5:1, honor prefers-reduced-motion, never convey status by color alone, full keyboard operability.
